title: OmniSearch mod.json
description: What Herdr reads from OmniSearch's mod.json, and the settings it takes.

title.description: The mod's name, as Herdr shows it.

place.description: Where Herdr first docks the mod.

font_size.title: Font size
font_size.description: Size of this mod's main text in px; smaller and larger text keep their proportion to it.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Scales this mod's icons, buttons and row heights. 1 is Herdr's own size.

list_width.title: List width
list_width.description: The share of the width the list of results takes; the preview gets the rest. The list is never narrower than 420px.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: Show the selected row's conversation or screen beside the list. It is always hidden where there is no room for it, as in a narrow pane.

mode.title: Opens on
mode.description: What OmniSearch lists when it opens: live terminals or old agent sessions. Tab switches while it is open.
